description: This file defines the 'dBug' class, a PHP utility for dumping and displaying variable contents in a styled, interactive HTML table format. It includes methods for type checking, recursive data structure handling, and XML parsing, along with embedded JavaScript and CSS for toggling visibility of data sections.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A PHP class for dumping variables in a styled, interactive HTML format with support for arrays, objects, resources, and XML data.

methods.name: dBug
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object, optionally forcing a specific type for dumping.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the variable name from the backtrace for display purposes.

methods.name: makeTableHeader
methods.description: Creates the main table header with styling and toggle functionality.

methods.name: makeTDHeader
methods.description: Creates a table row header for data display.

methods.name: closeTDRow
methods.description: Closes a table row.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Generates an error message for unsupported variable types.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Checks the variable's type and delegates to specific handlers.

methods.name: varIsNULL
methods.description: Handles null variables.

methods.name: varIsBoolean
methods.description: Handles boolean variables.

methods.name: varIsArray
methods.description: Handles array variables, including recursion detection.

methods.name: varIsObject
methods.description: Handles object variables, including recursion detection and method listing.

methods.name: varIsResource
methods.description: Handles resource variables, including database, GD, and XML resources.

methods.name: varIsDBResource
methods.description: Handles database resource variables, displaying fields and rows.

methods.name: varIsGDResource
methods.description: Handles GD image resources, displaying dimensions and color count.

methods.name: varIsXml
methods.description: Handles XML data by treating it as an XML resource.

methods.name: varIsXmlResource
methods.description: Parses and displays XML data with a built-in parser.

methods.name: xmlParse
methods.description: Parses XML data with error handling.

methods.name: xmlStartElement
methods.description: Handles start tags in XML parsing, building display data.

methods.name: xmlEndElement
methods.description: Handles end tags in XML parsing, finalizing display.

methods.name: xmlCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements.

methods.name: xmlDefaultHandler
methods.description: Handles miscellaneous XML data like comments.

methods.name: initJSandCSS
methods.description: Outputs embedded JavaScript and CSS for interactive toggling.
